does: Throws again each die at or below a reroll boost's face, through the whole-number draw on the stream, and keeps the new die when the boost says it always stands or when it is higher.

evidence.says: It draws with the roll's own faces and records the old and the new value in the result's list
A count-only probe on it shows one call for each roll with boosts, from +0x105CE8C, with no die thrown again when the roller has no reroll boost
